note: Independent bounded acceptance corpus for issue #46. Exactly one case is labelled user-observed for its credit body shape only; its AD-prefixed sender pairing, like every other sender pairing, is synthetic within the confirmed HDFCBK-S family. Every other body, amount, date and reference is synthetic. The observed UPI reference was masked by the user and is replaced here with a wholly fictional 12-digit value. All account digits, amounts, VPAs, references and timestamps are fictional.
